name: Lohagad

trails.name: Malavli station route
trails.note: Walk past Bhaje village and up to Gaimukh Khind, the saddle between Lohagad and Visapur, then the stepped path to the gates.

trails.name: Lohagadwadi steps
trails.note: Short stepped climb through the four gates. Good for families.

water: Rock-cut tanks on top; treat or filter before drinking.
Stalls at Lohagadwadi and sometimes near the gates sell water and nimbu sarbat.

landmarks.name: Four gates
landmarks.note: Ganesh, Narayan, Hanuman and Maha Darwaja, one after another on the stepped path.

landmarks.name: Vinchu Kata
landmarks.note: The 'scorpion's tail': a long, narrow spur on the west side with wide views.

landmarks.name: Gaimukh Khind
landmarks.note: Saddle between Lohagad and Visapur fort.

landmarks.name: Bhaja Caves
landmarks.note: Ancient Buddhist rock-cut caves above Bhaje village, on the way from Malavli.

safety: Very crowded on monsoon weekends; the steps get slippery and gates bottleneck.
Stay back from the Vinchu Kata edges, especially in fog.
Check the last local train back from Malavli before you start.

returnTransport.note: Pune–Lonavala local trains stop at Malavli; confirm the last train time towards Pune on the day.

en: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj captured Lohagad in 1648.
It was handed to the Mughals under the Treaty of Purandar in 1665 and won back in 1670.
Lohagad pairs with neighbouring Visapur; together they guarded the trade route through the Bor Ghat.
The Bhaja Caves nearby are among the oldest Buddhist rock-cut caves in Maharashtra.
mr: छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराजांनी १६४८ मध्ये लोहगड जिंकला.
१६६५ च्या पुरंदरच्या तहात तो मुघलांना द्यावा लागला आणि १६७० मध्ये पुन्हा जिंकला.
गडाच्या पश्चिमेला 'विंचूकाटा' नावाची लांब, निमुळती माची आहे.
पायथ्याजवळ भाजे येथे प्राचीन बौद्ध लेणी आहेत.
